# Perform a regression analysis for each region
import statsmodels.api as sm

# Separate the data by region
sub_saharan_data = merged_data[merged_data['Country Group'] == 'Sub-Saharan Africa']
lower_middle_income_data = merged_data[merged_data['Country Group'] == 'Lower middle income']

# Define the independent and dependent variables for Sub-Saharan Africa
X_sub_saharan = sm.add_constant(sub_saharan_data['Education_Expenditure'])
y_sub_saharan = sub_saharan_data['GNI_per_capita']

# Define the independent and dependent variables for Lower Middle Income countries
X_lower_middle_income = sm.add_constant(lower_middle_income_data['Education_Expenditure'])
y_lower_middle_income = lower_middle_income_data['GNI_per_capita']

# Fit the regression models
model_sub_saharan = sm.OLS(y_sub_saharan, X_sub_saharan).fit()
model_lower_middle_income = sm.OLS(y_lower_middle_income, X_lower_middle_income).fit()

# Print the summary of the regression models
model_sub_saharan.summary()
model_lower_middle_income.summary()

from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression

# Perform a regression analysis for each region using sklearn
# Sub-Saharan Africa
X_sub_saharan_sklearn = sub_saharan_data[['Education_Expenditure']]
y_sub_saharan_sklearn = sub_saharan_data['GNI_per_capita']

# Lower Middle Income countries
X_lower_middle_income_sklearn = lower_middle_income_data[['Education_Expenditure']]
y_lower_middle_income_sklearn = lower_middle_income_data['GNI_per_capita']

# Fit the regression models
model_sub_saharan_sklearn = LinearRegression().fit(X_sub_saharan_sklearn, y_sub_saharan_sklearn)
model_lower_middle_income_sklearn = LinearRegression().fit(X_lower_middle_income_sklearn, y_lower_middle_income_sklearn)

# Get the coefficients
coefficient_sub_saharan = model_sub_saharan_sklearn.coef_[0]
coefficient_lower_middle_income = model_lower_middle_income_sklearn.coef_[0]

coefficient_sub_saharan, coefficient_lower_middle_income
